text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thinking things over is fine and all, but 
your delicious black tea is going to get 
cold.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... let's see. I'd wager your slump 
started ever since your younger sister won 
that mock race the other day!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Because it's the same for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I love Dia like a sister, but... every 
time she improves her record, there's a 
part of me that feels just a little bit 
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I was just thinking that I'd like to 
win a GⅠ before you.
